children.title: Detecting Metareasoning Disconnects in Language Models

detail.title: Detecting Metareasoning Disconnects in Language Models
detail.question: Can transformer-based language models detect their own reasoning limitations or failure modes through self-reflection on chain-of-thought traces?
detail.reason: This project moves the inquiry to the selected topic 'unrecognized_reasoning_limits' by investigating whether models can diagnose the reasoning–answer gaps identified in the previous project.

children.title: Foundational Assumption Testing and Epistemic Self-Correction

detail.title: Foundational Assumption Testing and Epistemic Self-Correction
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Continuing structured inquiry into assumption testing.
